description: This file defines the class Subscription within the namespace Opencart\-Catalog\-Model\-Checkout. It provides methods to manage subscription data, including adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting subscription records, as well as handling subscription history and status updates. The class interacts with the database using SQL queries and extends the core system engine Model.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents the subscription model for handling subscription-related database operations such as creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting subscription data within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Inserts a new subscription record into the database with details such as order info, product options, pricing, billing cycle, and customer data.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record identified by subscription_id, modifying various fields such as order info, options, prices, and dates.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Removes subscription record(s) associated with a specific order ID from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record based on order ID and order product ID, decoding JSON fields for options and shipping details.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a subscription, tracking status changes and comments, and updating subscription status.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the status ID of a specific subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial period count for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Sets a new next billing date for a subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscriptions with optional filtering by subscription ID, order ID, or order product ID, including customer and status info.
